dialogues.jp:
まぶたに染み込む朝日に視覚神経を刺激され、
俺は｛かくせい／覚醒｝の時を迎えた。
dialogues.en:
The morning sun's rays penetrated my eyelids, alerting me
that the time to get up has arrived.
dialogues.text:
The morning sun's rays penetrated my eyelids, alerting me
that the time to get up has arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, onii-chan."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, onii-chan."

dialogues.jp:
目を開けると、何故か妹の｛ねむ／音夢｝が間近で顔を覗
き込んでいた。
dialogues.en:
As I open my eyes, for some reason, I see my sister right up
close to my face, peering at me.
dialogues.text:
As I open my eyes, for some reason, I see my sister right up
close to my face, peering at me.

dialogues.jp: 「なに……してるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What... are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "What... are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「先に目が覚めたから、お兄ちゃんの寝顔を見
　つめていたの……♪」
dialogues.en:
I woke up first, so I was just looking at your sleeping
face..."
dialogues.text:
I woke up first, so I was just looking at your sleeping
face..."

dialogues.jp:
全国１０００万の妹好きを下僕に出来るだろう、
笑顔と台詞が返ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Displaying the servitude of a million adoring younger
sisters, she replied with a smile.
dialogues.text:
Displaying the servitude of a million adoring younger
sisters, she replied with a smile.

dialogues.jp:
「そうじゃなくて……や、それでも良いんだけ
　ど、どうしてお前がここで寝てるんだって？」
dialogues.en:
"That isn't...well, disregarding that, why are you sleeping
here in the first place?
dialogues.text:
"That isn't...well, disregarding that, why are you sleeping
here in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうしてって……いつも一緒に寝てるけど？
　もう、お兄ちゃんったら、ボケボケさん♪」
dialogues.en:
"Why... don't we always sleep together? You're slow today,
onii-chan♪"
dialogues.text:
"Why... don't we always sleep together? You're slow today,
onii-chan♪"

dialogues.jp: そう言って、俺のデコを人差し指で軽く弾く。
dialogues.en: As she said that, her finger lightly tapped my forehead.
dialogues.text: As she said that, her finger lightly tapped my forehead.

dialogues.jp: いつも一緒に……寝てる？
dialogues.en: Always been...sleeping together?
dialogues.text: Always been...sleeping together?

dialogues.jp: 誰と誰が？
dialogues.en: Who and who?
dialogues.text: Who and who?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ねえ、お兄ちゃん。いつもの朝の挨拶……し
　て」
dialogues.en: "Hey, onii-chan... let's do our usual morning greeting."
dialogues.text: "Hey, onii-chan... let's do our usual morning greeting."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、音夢が瞳を閉じる。
dialogues.en: Nemu closed her eyes slowly with those words.
dialogues.text: Nemu closed her eyes slowly with those words.

dialogues.jp: これも……夢？
dialogues.en: This is... a dream?
dialogues.text: This is... a dream?

dialogues.jp:
そうだ、夢に違いない。こんな事が現実にあっ
ていいはずがない。
dialogues.en: Yes, it must be. There's no way this could be reality.
dialogues.text: Yes, it must be. There's no way this could be reality.

dialogues.jp: いや、イイ！！
dialogues.en: ...Wait, this is good!
dialogues.text: ...Wait, this is good!

dialogues.jp: そう、これは夢だ！
dialogues.en: This is a dream!
dialogues.text: This is a dream!

dialogues.jp: その瞬間、俺は――
dialogues.en: At this time, I--
dialogues.text: At this time, I--

dialogues.jp: 不敵になった。
dialogues.en: Have no fears!
dialogues.text: Have no fears!

dialogues.jp: 無敵になった！
dialogues.en: Am invincible!
dialogues.text: Am invincible!

dialogues.jp: 神だッ！！
dialogues.en: A God!!
dialogues.text: A God!!

dialogues.jp: 夢だと分かれば、もはや恐れるものは何もない！
dialogues.en:
Now that I know this is a dream, there's nothing to be
afraid of!
dialogues.text:
Now that I know this is a dream, there's nothing to be
afraid of!

dialogues.jp:
据え膳食わぬはなんとやら。ここは、ありがた
く頂戴しときましょう。
dialogues.en: The meal is laid before me. Now I must gratefully accept it.
dialogues.text: The meal is laid before me. Now I must gratefully accept it.

dialogues.jp: 「つー訳で、いただきます」
dialogues.en: "In that case, I'm ready."
dialogues.text: "In that case, I'm ready."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はい。ごちそうさま♪」
dialogues.en: "Okay, please enjoy!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, please enjoy!"

dialogues.jp: ゴスッ――
dialogues.en: --*glormph*
dialogues.text: --*glormph*

dialogues.jp: 「ふぐっ！？」
dialogues.en: "Hukk?!"
dialogues.text: "Hukk?!"

dialogues.jp: 硬い口づけとともに、食事は終わった。
dialogues.en:
Something hard entered my mouth, signalling the end of the
meal.
dialogues.text:
Something hard entered my mouth, signalling the end of the
meal.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう兄さん。今日もいい天気だよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Good morning nii-san. The weather's fantastic today~!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning nii-san. The weather's fantastic today~!"

dialogues.jp:
｛・・・・・／目を覚ます｝と、音夢が楽しげに俺の顔を覗き込
んで立っていた。
dialogues.en:
...Finally awakening, Nemu stood by my bedside, happily
peering into my face.
dialogues.text:
...Finally awakening, Nemu stood by my bedside, happily
peering into my face.

dialogues.jp: 「……ガキガキガキガキガキ……ガキ？」
dialogues.en: "....grblglg?"
dialogues.text: "....grblglg?"

dialogues.jp:
今度こそ朝か……そう口を動かしたのに不可解
な奇声が発せられた。
dialogues.en:
On this morning, the only words that could escape my mouth
was gibberish.
dialogues.text:
On this morning, the only words that could escape my mouth
was gibberish.

dialogues.jp:
俺の口には、枕元にあったはずの目覚まし時計
が、何故かくわえさせられている。
dialogues.en: In my mouth, was the unpleasant taste of my bedside clock.
dialogues.text: In my mouth, was the unpleasant taste of my bedside clock.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「美味しい？」
dialogues.en: "Tastes good?"
dialogues.text: "Tastes good?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……オイシイワケ、ネーダロウ」
dialogues.en: "...Of cohsh noht."
dialogues.text: "...Of cohsh noht."

dialogues.jp:
時計を吐き出して、顎をマッサージしながら｛うめ／呻｝
く。
dialogues.en:
I spit out the clock, moaning slightly while massaging my
cheeks and chin.
dialogues.text:
I spit out the clock, moaning slightly while massaging my
cheeks and chin.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なに言ってるの？　２０年前のロボットみた
　いだよ」
dialogues.en: "What was that? You sound like a robot from 20 years ago."
dialogues.text: "What was that? You sound like a robot from 20 years ago."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……オマエが発明したんだよ」
dialogues.en: "...That's your fault."
dialogues.text: "...That's your fault."

dialogues.jp: あ、普通に声が出た。
dialogues.en: Oh good, my normal voice returned.
dialogues.text: Oh good, my normal voice returned.

dialogues.jp: 「あーあー……よし。じゃ、お休み」
dialogues.en: "Haaa... alright. Good night!"
dialogues.text: "Haaa... alright. Good night!"

dialogues.jp: 敬礼して布団にもぐりこむ。
dialogues.en: A quick salute, and I fell back onto my futon.
dialogues.text: A quick salute, and I fell back onto my futon.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと。冗談ばっかやってると遅刻する
　よ！」
dialogues.en:
"Geez, if you mess around this much, you're going to be
late!"
dialogues.text:
"Geez, if you mess around this much, you're going to be
late!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫だ。俺はここから教室まで瞬間移動す
　ることが出来る」
dialogues.en:
"It's fine. I worked out exactly how much time I need to get
to the classroom from here."
dialogues.text:
"It's fine. I worked out exactly how much time I need to get
to the classroom from here."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「パジャマのままで教室行ってどうするの！」
dialogues.en: "So you're going to school in your pajamas?!"
dialogues.text: "So you're going to school in your pajamas?!"

dialogues.jp: むくりと起き上がる。
dialogues.en: I slowly rose from the futon again.
dialogues.text: I slowly rose from the futon again.

dialogues.jp: 「おはよう」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "...Sigh."
dialogues.text: "...Sigh."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、早く起きて下さいね」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, hurry up and get ready."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, hurry up and get ready."

dialogues.jp: そう言い残し、音夢が部屋を出て行こうとする。
dialogues.en: With a final parting shot, she started to leave the room.
dialogues.text: With a final parting shot, she started to leave the room.

dialogues.jp: 「待て、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Wait a minute, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute, Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp: ノブを握りながら振り返る。
dialogues.en:
With her hand on the doorknob, she turned her head back
towards me.
dialogues.text:
With her hand on the doorknob, she turned her head back
towards me.

dialogues.jp: 「朝の日課がまだだ」
dialogues.en: "We haven't done the morning routine yet."
dialogues.text: "We haven't done the morning routine yet."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「えっ、いいよ……今日は大丈夫だし……それ
　に時間も無いし……」
dialogues.en:
"Ehh, it's, fine... it's okay for today... besides, there's
no time...
dialogues.text:
"Ehh, it's, fine... it's okay for today... besides, there's
no time...

dialogues.jp:
両手を胸で組み、音夢が扉に背をはりつけて首
を振る。
dialogues.en:
Her arms across her chest, she hastily shook her head no
with her back to the doorway.
dialogues.text:
Her arms across her chest, she hastily shook her head no
with her back to the doorway.

dialogues.jp: 「つべこべ言わず、さっさと済ます」
dialogues.en: "Don't whine so much about it, let's just get it over with."
dialogues.text: "Don't whine so much about it, let's just get it over with."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Booo..."
dialogues.text: "Booo..."

dialogues.jp:
俺の指での呼びかけに、音夢は小さく｛うな／唸｝ってト
コトコと戻って来た。
dialogues.en:
Gesturing her over with my finger, Nemu let out a small moan
and slowly returned.
dialogues.text:
Gesturing her over with my finger, Nemu let out a small moan
and slowly returned.

dialogues.jp: 間近で見つめる頬が真っ赤になっている。
dialogues.en:
With her face so close to mine, I can see the red flush in
her cheeks.
dialogues.text:
With her face so close to mine, I can see the red flush in
her cheeks.

dialogues.jp: 「いいか」
dialogues.en: "Ready?"
dialogues.text: "Ready?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "...Yeah."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
音夢はベッドの脇で前かがみになり、腰を曲げ
て俺の肩に手をつく。
dialogues.en:
Nemu stood facing the bedside, her hips bending slightly and
her hands on my shoulders.
dialogues.text:
Nemu stood facing the bedside, her hips bending slightly and
her hands on my shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
二人の距離は急速に縮まり、互いの吐息を感じ
るまでになる。
dialogues.en:
As the distance between us rapidly decreased, we could feel
each other's breath.
dialogues.text:
As the distance between us rapidly decreased, we could feel
each other's breath.

dialogues.jp: 唇のシワが数えられる距離。
dialogues.en: Close enough to count the creases on her lips.
dialogues.text: Close enough to count the creases on her lips.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の後頭部に手を回し――腕を引く。
dialogues.en: I put my hand on the back of Nemu's head... and pulled.
dialogues.text: I put my hand on the back of Nemu's head... and pulled.

dialogues.jp: ゴツッ――
dialogues.en: --*thud*
dialogues.text: --*thud*

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いたたた！」
dialogues.en: "Owowow!"
dialogues.text: "Owowow!"

dialogues.jp: オデコをくっつけて熱を測る。
dialogues.en: I used my forehead to measure the hotness of hers.
dialogues.text: I used my forehead to measure the hotness of hers.

dialogues.jp: 「うん、いつも通りの微熱かな」
dialogues.en: "Okay, just the usual slight fever."
dialogues.text: "Okay, just the usual slight fever."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うう〜……どうしていつも頭突きになるの？」
dialogues.en: "Uu... Why must we always butt heads like this?"
dialogues.text: "Uu... Why must we always butt heads like this?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「熱を測ってるんだから、しょうがないだろ」
dialogues.en: "I have to measure your temperature. You know it's no joke."
dialogues.text: "I have to measure your temperature. You know it's no joke."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、もうこれ体温計にしようよ」
dialogues.en: "Can't we use a thermometer instead?"
dialogues.text: "Can't we use a thermometer instead?"

dialogues.jp: デコをさすりながら音夢が呟く。
dialogues.en: Nemu muttered while rubbing her forehead.
dialogues.text: Nemu muttered while rubbing her forehead.

dialogues.jp:
「身体弱いくせに、体温計の表示を誤魔化す癖
　がなおったらな」
dialogues.en:
"You've always had a weak constitution, a thermometer
wouldn't be reliable in your case."
dialogues.text:
"You've always had a weak constitution, a thermometer
wouldn't be reliable in your case."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「むぅぅ〜〜」
dialogues.en: "Booooo..."
dialogues.text: "Booooo..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ体温計でもいいが、お前がちゃんと計っ
　てるか、ずっと見ててもいいんだな？」
dialogues.en:
"Besides, if we used a thermometer, would you be able to
take me supervising you through it?"
dialogues.text:
"Besides, if we used a thermometer, would you be able to
take me supervising you through it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「シャツの上のボタンをはずして、首元から中
　に手を差し入れるところまで全部だぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"With the top button of your shirt unfastened, putting the
thermometer under your arm?"
dialogues.text:
"With the top button of your shirt unfastened, putting the
thermometer under your arm?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うわっ！？　そんな説明しなくていいよぉ」
dialogues.en: "Waah!? Don't say it like that!"
dialogues.text: "Waah!? Don't say it like that!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……俺だって恥ずかしいんだから諦めろ」
dialogues.en: "...Fine."
dialogues.text: "...Fine."

dialogues.jp:
だいたい普通逆だろう。少なくとも、毎日学校
を休めるなら俺はありがたいが。
dialogues.en:
Not the normal morning chatter. At least it's a short break
from the normal school routine, something to be thankful
for.
dialogues.text:
Not the normal morning chatter. At least it's a short break
from the normal school routine, something to be thankful
for.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「むぅ〜……とにかく、早くしないと遅刻しま
　すからね」
dialogues.en: "Man... anyway, hurry up before it gets any later."
dialogues.text: "Man... anyway, hurry up before it gets any later."

dialogues.jp:
ドアの向こうに音夢が消え、足音が遠ざかって
いく。
dialogues.en: Nemu disappears out the door, her footsteps growing distant.
dialogues.text: Nemu disappears out the door, her footsteps growing distant.

dialogues.en: Sleeeepy....
dialogues.text: Sleeeepy....

dialogues.jp: このまま、また眠ってしまおうか？
dialogues.en: Should I sleep a bit longer?
dialogues.text: Should I sleep a bit longer?

dialogues.jp: ◆夢の、はじまり◆
dialogues.en: ◆Beginning of the Dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆Beginning of the Dream◆

dialogues.jp:
おかしな夢を見た。ここぞという所で、強制
的に目覚めさせられてしまう運命ではあった
が……。
dialogues.en:
I had a weird dream. I was then rather forcefully
awakened...
dialogues.text:
I had a weird dream. I was then rather forcefully
awakened...

dialogues.jp:
起こしたのは音夢。目覚ましを食わせるという
荒技を使いやがった。
dialogues.en:
The one who did so was Nemu. To wake me up, she stuffed my
mouth rather roughly.
dialogues.text:
The one who did so was Nemu. To wake me up, she stuffed my
mouth rather roughly.

dialogues.jp:
いつものようにおでことおでこを合わせて体温
を測ると、音夢の姿はドアの向こうに消えた。
dialogues.en:
After doing the usual morning forehead-to-forehead checkup,
Nemu's figure disappeared beyond the door.
dialogues.text:
After doing the usual morning forehead-to-forehead checkup,
Nemu's figure disappeared beyond the door.
